crossRefs.note: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good…
crossRefs.keyword: well as power in order to effect his ruin

crossRefs.note: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

translations.web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
translations.bsb: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
translations.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
translations.asv: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.
